items.prompt:
What is a WORD PROCESSOR?
A) A machine that shreds paper
B) A computer program you use to type, format, and edit writing
C) A printer
D) A scanner

steps: A word processor is software that lets you type and edit text. Examples include Microsoft Word and Google Docs.

items.prompt:
Which tool would MOST help a student check for spelling errors while typing a report?
A) A dictionary on the shelf
B) A pencil and eraser
C) Spell-check software on a computer
D) A ruler

steps: Spell-check automatically identifies misspelled words and suggests corrections, which is the fastest way to check spelling while typing.

items.prompt: True or False: When you type a story on a computer, you can easily change a word without erasing anything.
items.answer: True. On a computer, you can delete a word and retype a new one without any mess.

steps: Computers let you edit text digitally. You can delete, retype, or move text with no erasing needed.

items.prompt: Name ONE digital tool a student could use to share a story with classmates.
items.answer: Sample: email, class website, Google Classroom, shared online document.

steps: Digital sharing tools include email, class websites, blogs, or learning management systems like Google Classroom.

items.prompt: A student types 'teh' instead of 'the.' What will the spell-checker do?
items.answer: The spell-checker will underline the word in red to show it may be misspelled and suggest 'the' as a correction.

steps: Spell-check flags possibly misspelled words and often suggests the correct spelling.

items.prompt:
Which is an example of PUBLISHING your writing using a digital tool?
A) Writing in your journal at home
B) Posting your story on the class website so others can read it
C) Drawing a picture about your story
D) Reading your story quietly to yourself

steps: Publishing means sharing your writing with an audience. Posting it on a class website is a digital way to publish.

items.prompt: Name TWO things a word processor can do that a pencil and paper cannot.
items.answer: Sample: (1) Automatically check spelling. (2) Let you delete and retype without erasing. (3) Allow you to copy and paste text. (4) Let you change the font size or style.

steps: Word processors offer spell-check, easy deletion/insertion, copy-paste, and formatting options that are not possible with pencil and paper.

items.prompt: A student wants to write a story WITH a partner. They live in different houses. How can digital tools help them work together?
items.answer: They can share an online document (such as a Google Doc) so both students can type and edit the story at the same time from their own homes.

steps: Shared documents allow two or more people to work on the same file at the same time, even from different locations.

items.prompt:
What does 'publish' mean in writing?
A) To throw your writing away
B) To share your writing with an audience
C) To edit your writing for spelling
D) To write your rough draft

steps: Publishing means making your work available for others to read. In a classroom, this might mean printing it, posting it online, or reading it aloud.

items.prompt:
Which is NOT a digital tool for writing?
A) A tablet with a keyboard
B) A class blog
C) A pencil
D) A word processing program

steps: A pencil is a physical writing tool, not a digital one. Tablets, blogs, and word processors are all digital tools.

items.prompt: A student printed her story and hung it on the classroom wall. Is this a form of publishing? Why or why not?
items.answer: Yes. Publishing means sharing your writing with an audience. Hanging a printed story on the wall shares it with classmates and other readers.

steps: Publishing does not have to be online. Any time you make your writing available for others to read, you are publishing it.

items.prompt: List ONE advantage and ONE disadvantage of typing your writing instead of handwriting it.
items.answer: Advantage: Easy to edit — you can delete and retype without making the page messy. Disadvantage: You need access to a computer or tablet, and typing can be slow if you are still learning the keyboard.

steps: Advantages of typing: fast editing, spell-check, easy sharing.
Disadvantages: requires a device, may be slower for beginners.

items.prompt:
Which sentence describes COLLABORATIVE digital writing?
A) A student types a story alone on a computer.
B) Two students work together on the same shared online document to write a report.
C) A student reads a book on a tablet.
D) A teacher types a list of spelling words.

steps: Collaborative writing means two or more people working together on the same document. A shared online document makes this possible.

items.prompt: A student finishes writing a story on the computer. Her teacher says, 'Now publish it.' What should the student do?
items.answer: The student should share her story with an audience. She could print it, post it on the class website, email it, or share it in a class book.

steps: Publishing = sharing with an audience. Options include printing, posting online, or emailing.

items.prompt: Describe how a student could use TWO different digital tools during the writing process: one for writing and one for sharing.
items.answer: Sample: The student could use a word processor (like Google Docs) to type and edit their report, using spell-check to catch errors. Then they could email the final version to their teacher or post it on the class website so classmates can read it.

steps: Writing tool: word processor or typing program.
Sharing tool: email, class website, Google Classroom, or digital portfolio.
